pages.text: Six new canvases join the painting pool, all signed by the pack's court painter, $(thing)CoolFreeze23$(). Place a painting and they're in the random rotation alongside vanilla's; creative mode lets you pick them outright.$(p)Every one depicts something in this book that has tried to kill you. Art imitates life; life bites back.

pages.title: The Gallery
pages.text: $(item)The King$() (4x3) — his majesty, from a safe distance. There is no safe distance.$(br)$(item)Mobzilla Rises$() (3x4) — the tall one. The painting is also tall.$(br)$(item)Terror of the Deep$() (4x2) — the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/kraken)Kraken$() in its element, which is everywhere wet.

pages.title: The Gallery II
pages.text: $(item)First Date$() (2x2) — a quiet moment; see $(l:orespawn_integrations:her_side/date_night)Date Night$() if it gives you ideas.$(br)$(item)Flight of the Prince$() (4x2) — the white dragon mid-$(l:orespawn_integrations:modern_wonders/a_reactive_world)flyover$().$(br)$(item)Crystal Wastes$() (2x2) — the $(l:orespawn_integrations:dimensions/crystal_dimension)Crystal Dimension$(), flattering light included.

pages.title: Arena Digs
pages.text: Every newly generated Mobzilla Arena floor hides $(thing)four suspicious gravel$() patches. Bring a brush: they surface uranium and titanium nuggets, rubies, bone blocks, trex teeth, and godzilla scales — with rare full ingots and, once in a blue moon, a Pigstep disc somebody dropped mid-evacuation.

pages.title: Lair Digs
pages.text: The Kraken Lair's seabed digs skew nautical: kraken teeth, prismarine shards and crystals, salt, sea monster and water dragon scales, sea viper tongues, rubies — plus a rare heart of the sea or an unhatched sniffer egg.$(p)Archaeology at crush depth. Bring water breathing and patience, in that order.

pages.title: Trail Ruins Salt
pages.text: Vanilla trail ruins learned the local geology too. Common digs can now surface uranium and titanium nuggets or a ruby among the sherds, and rare digs add rubies and a full $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/tigers_eye)tiger's eye ingot$() to the pool.$(p)The ancients were prospecting. The ancients were right.
